newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-SHEFFIELD WEDNESDAY SIGN ITALIAN MIDFIELDER CARBONE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SHEFFIELD WEDNESDAY SIGN ITALIAN MIDFIELDER CARBONE.

text.p: English premier league side Sheffield Wednesday confirmed on Monday they have signed Italian midfielder Benito Carbone for a club record three million pounds sterling ($4.70 million).
Carbone, a former under-21 international, lost his place in the Inter Milan side this season.
"He'll be exciting the fans here for years to come." manager David Pleat said.
"It's a real coup for our club and a big one by anybody's standards. I'm looking forward to him scaring a few defences, entertaining a lot of people and really doing well for Sheffield Wednesday."
Carbone joins compatriots Gianluca Vialli and Roberto Di Matteo of Chelsea and Middlesbrough's Fabrizio Ravenelli in the premier league.
Sheffield Wednesday have not won any of their last seven matches after starting the season with four straight victories.
